admissions.operation: Maintain androgen receptor signalling so motivation, stamina, and goal-directed effort remain well supported.
admissions.biological_role: Adequate zinc supply supports testosterone availability; restriction and repletion studies identify a conditional upstream contribution to androgen ligand supply.

scientific_assessment.operation: Maintain androgen receptor signalling so motivation, stamina, and goal-directed effort remain well supported.

functional_dependency.statement: Dietary zinc maintains the metal pool supporting the androgen receptor’s zinc-finger DNA-binding capacity.

dietary_supply.statement: The same mineral is supplied by verified canonical composition records; homeostatic uptake and distribution mediate receptor loading. No excess-intake or testosterone efficacy requirement is inferred.

scientific_assessment.assessment_limitations: This Type A relationship concerns the receptor DNA-binding domain, not stimulation of testosterone production, tissue receptor occupancy, motivation or benefit from extra zinc. Cellular zinc homeostasis and receptor expression constrain metal availability. The primary crystal used an engineered rat receptor domain; human domain identity is curated. A zinc-finger mutation study tested an arginine substitution, not dietary zinc depletion.

food_target_research.sufficient_coverage_rationale: Existing verified zinc composition records provide varied sources; no additional food edge or effective receptor-response dose is inferred.
